description: Ex-VNAF Hercules displayed at the Ben Duoc section of the Cu Chi tunnels historic site, with its own page on the site's official website. A January 2025 visitor report gives 5-0532 and an ex-USAF 56-476 identity, but the same report gives that identity for the C-130 at Ta Con as well, so no number is asserted here.
Wrecked Huey displayed at the Cu Chi tunnels site; a hulk rather than a complete airframe.
